monetary_basis.consistency_rule: constant-dollar cash flows + real discount rate

routing.reserve_policy: constant annual worst-case reserve above technical SOCmin

frozen_eob.classification: FROZEN EOB COMPARATOR FOR PREMIUM CALCULATION

production_claim_boundary: Source authority only. Requires separately approved committed runner+manifest, annotated tag at HEAD, matching live origin and explicit production invocation. This manifest does not certify any optimization or constitute solve authorization.
non_self_reference: Runner SHA is external here. Neither this file nor runner embeds its own future containing commit or own hash. Future annotated tag points to containing commit and its identity is approved separately.

worktree_policy.tracked: All tracked/index changes rejected in production; exact HEAD blob/worktree bytes required for runner and manifest.
worktree_policy.untracked: Only known unrelated docs/protocols/iris_thesis_rigorous_audit_skill.md is a standard-untracked exception. Runner/manifest are audit-only exceptions before freeze.
worktree_policy.ignored: Existing Git-ignored scripts/src/data inventory is exact-path and exact-byte pinned. New or changed entries reject; archival classification is not permission to route them as model input.
worktree_policy.bytecode: No new bytecode writes by runner. Existing cache bytes remain separately pinned; do not silently regenerate caches during freeze.
